latestReleaseGate.evidenceBoundary: The accepted hosted-CI baseline remains GitHub Actions run 30471584219: 241 automated tests, 78 Convex-focused tests, production build, and all 39 active Chromium journeys passed without retry or flaky annotation, with one unrelated background-visibility case explicitly skipped. Protected-preview commit e9a3676 separately passed the full 255-test local suite, including 79 Convex-focused tests, lint, typecheck, production build, and git diff validation. Vercel deployment dpl_363hLXcnrTqEEoCwLiQQYzxsY6fR built READY from exact commit e9a367678ad3e2aa602937a95084604044a349c1 and received stable alias https://realworld-cloud-preview-mosnins-projects.vercel.app. The UI now presents exact authorized connection health only after current active Convex Mission, room, readiness, and membership-grant eligibility; stale same-room cleanup, grant changes, archive, missing readiness, feature-off, and observer callback failures fail closed. No provider id, identity, roster, or occupant count is rendered. Live owner and isolated reviewer sessions both showed Live room signals, the owner Workshop interior retained the same status, and Ably showed two simultaneous distinct pseudonymous SDK 2.26.0 connections. A local issuer regression proves fresh issuance is denied after membership revocation and an already signed request is bounded to five minutes; it does not prove provider-side termination of an already active connection. Production was not connected or changed. This proves truthful protected-preview connection-health presentation on top of the prior token issuance, exact room capability isolation, disconnect cleanup, and reconnect evidence. It does not prove a privacy-safe presence roster, cursor or selection UI, live active-connection revocation, simultaneous durable cloud edits, background recovery, load, agent runtime, or production readiness.
